# ADR-3084: A07: Documented step-up auth exemption for read API 12

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Step-up friction can harm UX on reads.

## Decision

APIs MAY adopt a documented step-up auth exemption for read API 12 (A07-12) when low-risk reads would over-prompt users.

## Consequences

Exemptions exclude sensitive fields.
